meta.name: openclaw-secure-linux-cloud
meta.description: Use when self-hosting OpenClaw on a cloud server, hardening a remote OpenClaw gateway, choosing between SSH tunneling, Tailscale, or reverse-proxy exposure, or reviewing Podman, pairing, sandboxing, token auth, and tool-permission defaults for a secure personal deployment.

copy.tagline: 加固云服务器上的自托管部署
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果自己部署服务并需要加固安全配置
copy.tagline_en: Harden self-hosted deployments on cloud servers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you self-host services and need to harden security

howto.what: Claude 会指导你安全地在云服务器上部署 OpenClaw，包括加固 Linux 主机、使用 SSH 隧道访问控制界面、启用令牌认证和沙箱等安全措施。
howto.when: 当你提到在云服务器上自托管 OpenClaw、加固远程网关、选择 SSH 隧道/Tailscale/反向代理，或审查 Podman、配对、沙箱、令牌认证等安全配置时触发。

say.text: 我想在云服务器上安全部署 OpenClaw，该怎么做？
say.note: Claude 会给出从零开始的部署步骤。

say.text: 检查我现有的 OpenClaw 部署是否有安全风险。
say.note: Claude 会审查配置并指出暴露风险。

say.text: SSH 隧道和 Tailscale 哪个更适合远程访问 OpenClaw？
say.note: Claude 会对比并推荐最低风险的方案。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you to securely deploy OpenClaw on a cloud server, including hardening the Linux host, accessing the Control UI via SSH tunnel, and enabling token auth, sandboxing, and other security defaults.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention self-hosting OpenClaw on a cloud server, hardening a remote gateway, choosing between SSH tunnel/Tailscale/reverse proxy, or reviewing Podman, pairing, sandboxing, token auth, or tool permissions.

say_en.text: I want to deploy OpenClaw securely on a cloud server. How?
say_en.note: Claude will provide step-by-step deployment instructions.

say_en.text: Audit my existing OpenClaw deployment for security risks.
say_en.note: Claude will review config and point out exposure issues.

say_en.text: Which is better for remote OpenClaw access: SSH tunnel or Tailscale?
say_en.note: Claude will compare and recommend the lowest-risk option.
